column2: A heroic knight in shiny steel plate armour with a bright blue tunic and blue helmet plume, holding a long blue-and-white striped jousting lance pointed straight forward, riding a giant blue-grey ostrich with long strong legs, the ostrich wings folded tight against its body, chunky stylized toy-like proportions, side 3/4 view

A villain knight in dull iron armour with a red tunic and red helmet plume, holding a long red jousting lance pointed forward, riding a large scruffy brown buzzard vulture standing on two legs, the buzzard wings folded tight against its body, chunky stylized toy-like proportions

A villain knight in silver-grey armour with a grey cloak and spiked helmet, holding a long grey jousting lance pointed forward, riding a large dark grey buzzard vulture standing on two legs, wings folded tight against its body, chunky stylized toy-like proportions

A menacing knight in black and deep purple armour with glowing violet visor slit, holding a long black jousting lance pointed forward, riding a large black buzzard vulture with purple-tipped feathers standing on two legs, wings folded tight, chunky stylized toy-like proportions
A large scruffy brown buzzard vulture with an empty leather saddle on its back, standing on two legs, wings folded tight against its body, chunky stylized toy-like proportions
A fearsome orange-red pterodactyl with a long pointed beak and crest, wings spread wide as solid thick leathery shapes, chunky stylized toy-like proportions, side view in flight
A single large speckled golden egg with a soft magical glow, chunky stylized, standing upright

A long floating rock island ledge, flat mossy grass top with a few tiny flowers, chunky stylized weathered sandstone and ancient carved stone blocks underneath tapering to a rough point, wide and thin like a shelf, about 6 times wider than tall
A short floating rock island ledge, flat mossy grass top, chunky stylized weathered sandstone and ancient carved stone blocks underneath tapering to a rough point, about 3 times wider than tall

A wide ancient stone bridge platform, flat mossy carved stone top, chunky stylized weathered sandstone pillars and blocks below, glowing orange underside as if lit by lava, very wide and low, about 8 times wider than tall
A small round ancient stone pedestal with a glowing turquoise rune circle inlaid on its flat top, chunky stylized weathered sandstone, short and wide
